question: Pondicherry was captured by the Dutch in 1693 but was returned to the French company by the Treaty of Ryswick in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1699**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pondicherry** was captured by the **Dutch** in **1693**. It became an important colonial settlement due to its strategic location.
 
• The **Treaty of Ryswick**, signed in **1697**, marked the end of the Nine Years' War between France and the Grand Alliance.
 
• By the terms of the treaty, colonial possessions captured during the war were restored to their original owners. Hence, **Pondicherry was returned** to the French East India Company in **1699**.
 
• This event highlighted the importance of diplomatic agreements in resolving territorial disputes during the colonial era.
